arguments.query: SELECT name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'bookings' AS kind,json_group_array(json_object('id',booking_id,'request',request_id,'flight',flight_id,'passenger',passenger_id,'amount',amount_cents,'status',status,'client',client_reference,'confirmed_at',confirmed_at)) AS data FROM bookings UNION ALL SELECT 'charges',json_group_array(json_object('id',charge_id,'booking',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'step',created_step)) FROM charges UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_group_array(json_object('id',event_id,'booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts)) FROM outbox UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_events',json_group_array(json_object('id',event_id,'request',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step)) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'flights',json_group_array(json_object('id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version)) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_group_array(json_object('key',key,'value',value)) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'configs',json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',value)) FROM service_config

SELECT 'pending' AS kind,json_group_array(json_object('id',b.booking_id,'request',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'client',b.client_reference,'charge',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'customer_cancel_step',e.step,'has_hold',h.booking_id IS NOT NULL)) AS data FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN holds h USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN customer_events e USING(request_id) WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox_pending',json_group_array(json_object('id',o.event_id,'booking',o.booking_id,'payload',o.payload,'attempts',o.attempts,'booking_status',b.status,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id)) FROM outbox o LEFT JOIN bookings b USING(booking_id) WHERE o.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_events',json_group_array(json_object('id',event_id,'request',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step)) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_holds',json_group_array(json_object('id',hold_id,'flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step)) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'configs',json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',value)) FROM service_config

SELECT 'pending' AS kind,json_group_array(json_object('id',b.booking_id,'request',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'charge',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'cancel_step',e.step)) AS data FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN customer_events e USING(request_id) WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled',json_group_array(json_object('id',b.booking_id,'cancel_step',e.step,'charge',c.charge_id,'state',c.state,'amount',c.amount_cents,'refund',r.amount_cents,'holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id),'checkins',(SELECT count(*) FROM checkins k WHERE k.booking_id=b.booking_id))) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN refunds r USING(charge_id) LEFT JOIN customer_events e ON b.request_id=e.request_id WHERE b.status='cancelled' UNION ALL SELECT 'confirmed_missing_backing',json_group_array(b.booking_id) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND ((SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id)<>1 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents=b.amount_cents)<>1 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM checkins k WHERE k.booking_id=b.booking_id AND k.flight_id=b.flight_id AND k.passenger_id=b.passenger_id)<>1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered' AND json_extract(o.payload,'$.booking_id')=b.booking_id AND json_extract(o.payload,'$.flight_id')=b.flight_id AND json_extract(o.payload,'$.passenger_id')=b.passenger_id)) UNION ALL SELECT 'configs',json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',value)) FROM service_config
